parameters.formDescription: One batch of contacts to source, verify and file. The pipeline fills a batch, checks every row against the rules, and sends anything unverifiable to a person.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ run_id: 'research:' + $json.id, execute: false, title: 'Research row ' + $json.id + ' — ' + ($json.defects || 'exception'), actions: [ { id: 'approve', label: 'Approve' }, { id: 'replace', label: 'Replace' }, { id: 'drop', label: 'Drop' } ], fields: [ { label: 'Row', value: $json.id }, { label: 'Company', value: $json.company }, { label: 'Defects', value: $json.defects }, { label: 'Source', value: $json.source_url } ], payload: { exception_id: $json.id, batch_id: $('Prepare Batch').first().json.batch_id }, callback_url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5678/webhook/shotty-research-decision' }) }}
